_comment: WCSim BoxandLine20inchHQE detection probability per photon reaching the PMT, as the HK production runs it (WCSim v1.12.34, PMTQEMethod SensitiveDetector_Only, PMTCollEff on): the glass/cathode surface reflects rgcff 0.32, the rest converts at QE_table x 1/0.73 (B&L correction, WCSimPMTObject.cc) x 1/(1 - 0.25) (WCSimWCSD.cc:213) x collection efficiency 0.95. So qe = 0.68/0.75 x QE_table/0.73 x 0.95. LUCiD's QE is per photon reaching the PMT (deposits convert at QE/(1-R0)), so this pairs with sensor_reflection_rate 0.32.
